prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1189; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle that was rear-ended.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was at a traffic light in Baytown, Texas, on a weekday afternoon. I was stopped at the light, waiting for it to turn green.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then forward, and my hands came off the steering wheel. My car lurched into the intersection a little, but I stayed in my lane.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: No. I was looking at the light, and I didn't see it until the impact. I heard brakes squeal right before it hit.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle and speak with the other driver?

A: Yes, the other driver came over. He said he was looking at his phone and didn't stop in time. Police were called and came out to file a report.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, the ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my left wrist and told me it was fractured. I've since been to an orthopedic doctor, and I'm wearing a cast and have been told I may need surgery.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?

A: Yes, I have follow-up appointments scheduled, and I'm doing physical therapy as soon as the doctor clears it. I'm not able to work my usual shifts right now because of the wrist.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was stopped and doing nothing wrong. I'd like this handled as quickly as possible.
